newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish car registrations up in Nov - industry body.
newsitem.headline: Swedish car registrations up in Nov - industry body.

text.p: Swedish new car registrations rose 26 percent in November to 19,147, industry organisation AB Bilstatistik said on Monday.
New car registrations so far this year totalled 166,227, or seven percent more than in the first 11 months of 1995.
Volvo's 800 model accounted for 20,660 registrations, compared to 22,123 in the same period last year, while the 900 series accounted for 11,677 cars compared to 17,499 cars.
The Volkswagen Golf was the third most popular car, the statistics showed, with 8,528 registered compared to 7,337 cars in the period last year.
Next was the Ford Escort at 7,507 cars compared to 7,004, followed by the Saab 900 at 6,876 cars against 8,253 cars a year earlier. Registrations of the Saab 9000 fell to 6,848 from 8,607.
Registrations of Volvo's new S40/V40 series rose to 5,851 from 15.
